news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.19 (vs ₹0.76 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.19 (up from ₹0.76 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.02b (up 61% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹6.90m (up ₹33.9m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.3% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 128 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.1% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks.
